# RayVo Studio

> RayVo Studio designs and runs the technical side of your projects: event production, installation, lighting design, programming and equipment rental. One team, from the first site visit to on-site operation.

## Site
- [RayVo Studio (English)](https://rayvo-studio.github.io/rayvo-studio/recrutement/): services, work, process, contact
- [RayVo Studio (Français)](https://rayvo-studio.github.io/rayvo-studio/fr/recrutement/): version française du site

## Services
- Event production — We handle the technical side of your event: equipment, installation, programming and live operation, from load-in to load-out.
- Installation — We install and upgrade lighting, sound, control and programming systems in clubs, venues and public spaces.
- Design & programming — Show design, technical drawings, 3D renders and lighting programming on the console: the show is written and approved before the event.
- Technical services — Tailored technical support: preparation, live operation and follow-up, as reinforcement or running your project end to end.
- Rental — Sound, lighting and backline rental to complete your own set-up or cover a one-off need.
- Clubs — Designing or upgrading an installation, programming the lighting and ongoing technical support for clubs and nightclubs.
